title: The Enemy doesn’t just want to hurt you; he wants to change you. ⚔️🛡️
paragraphs: The Enemy doesn’t just want to hurt you; he wants to change you. ⚔️🛡️
The hardest battle you will ever fight isn’t against the person attacking you—it’s the battle against becoming just like them.

When the world hands you bitterness, and you choose to remain kind... that isn’t weakness. That is spiritual warfare at its highest level. Don't let the darkness of others dim the light within you. Your integrity is worth more than your revenge.
Stay soft. Stay dangerous. Stay faithful.
📖 The Word: "Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good." — Romans 12:21
